name: Convex-Treelike Peripheral-Expansion Theorem
statement: For an isometric site $S\subseteq B$, the specified peripheral expansion belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ if and only if both $B$ and $S$ do.
proof: The forward direction follows because the base and duplicated site are convex semicubes; the reverse direction is the defining two-child closure rule.
